QuestInfo.name: Celebrity Stinks
QuestInfo.0: Tina doesn't seem real thrilled about the autograph event. What needs to be done?
QuestInfo.1: Tina wants you to find a suitable cologne for Blake's autograph event. She wants 3 samples to try. The perfume shop is on the #b5th Floor 6th Floor Area A Music Shop#k.
QuestInfo.2: Blake doesn't seem to like any of the colognes. He's from Kerning Square, yet he badmouths the place constantly. What's his problem?

0.0: We need cologne first. Blake is very sensitive about his smell. I know that sounds weird, but famous people are allowed to be kinda weird, y'know?
0.1: We should let Blake pick out a cologne he likes. He's quite picky... And such a pain to deal with... Anyway, can you round up some colognes for Blake to try?

yes.0: The #bPerfume Shop#k is on the #b5th and 6th floor#k in the Kerning Square Shopping Center. Get a Blue Perfume, Yellow Perfume, and Pink Perfume and deliver them to Blake.
yes.1: You may pass by the Perfume Shop since it's so small. Take the portal on #b5th Floor 6th Floor Area A#k to go to the shop.

no.0: Ah, you're busy? I hope Blake doesn't throw a tantrum...

1.0: Oh, are those my colognes? Here, lemme see if you got any good ones...

yes.0: Hey, these are all from Kerning Square, aren't they? I'm not wearing some nasty stuff from this dump. Get me something imported.
yes.1: Well there isn't time to get other colognes, so just do your best.

npc.0: The Perfume Shop is on the 5th and 6th floor in Kerning Square Shopping Center. Get a Blue Perfume, Yellow Perfume, and Pink Perfume and deliver them to Blake.
npc.1: You may pass by the Perfume Shop since it's so small. Take the portal on #b5th Floor 6th Floor Area A#k to go to the shop.

item.0: What is Tina doing, taking a coffee break? Come on!
